notes.title: Knightly Passions by FEYADA : Steam Release !!!
notes.notes:
Yesterday, our friends at Team FEYADA released their game, Knightly Passions, on Steam. The game is available to be picked up now at a great price! Hurry while the discount lasts!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1554260/Knightly_Passions

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385322/ed5277aa00725c36afe18cabff58ac99ce873e44.jpg


”Knightly Passions” is a nonlinear visual novel with RPG elements  that brings together the very best aspects of the genre. In it, you alone can decide how to act in challenging situations, who to consider a friend or enemy, and how to interact with any given character. And it is up to you alone to become the greatest warrior and champion of a downtrodden world!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385322/652887078b036220404aa44c2638dec2280f32c0.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385322/ca945d814536f466146967dba1d2dd66234f6642.png

In addition to combat encounters, players will encounter open-world challenges. You’ll not only face a diverse array of traps and puzzles, but also a host of different interactive minigames designed to add variety to gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385322/da6976ea9b8c82dc951a1463dde3e564de90edfd.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385322/2f8ec9af6ac16adf0c60a94cc4506228447e13c8.png

An excellent addition to all of the above is the abundance of splendid ladies, including a Vampire, Witch, Elf, Werewolf, Arachnid, and so on. Building relationships with these beauties also takes quite some time, and the result will be horny scenes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385322/221759a4ebd6c5e0408acac88951b65ae9ebb957.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385322/eecc565e8cea17660a426de46bcc38fb617fca39.png

Don't forget to leave reviews! The Knightly Passions devs have worked really hard to make sure you enjoy the game.
